The consumer and provider experiences run through app.seasonhealth.com; the company is a HIPAA-covered digital health service. Season Health is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs — api.seasonhealth.com is a private application backend — so this profile captures the company's real public web properties rather than an API program.

providers.name: Lifesum
providers.description: Lifesum is a Stockholm-based digital health company whose consumer mobile application helps people improve their well-being through food logging, calorie and macronutrient tracking, personalized meal plans, recipes, and habit building. Backed by Balderton Capital, the company operates a subscription business-to-consumer product across iOS and Android in a dozen languages. As of this profile Lifesum publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or partner API portal, so this entry is an identity-only company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Calysta
providers.description: Calysta, Inc. is a cellular agriculture company founded in 2012 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, with operations in Memphis, Tennessee (NouriTech), Wilton/Teesside in the United Kingdom (Calysta UK Ltd.) and Singapore (Calysta Asia Pte Ltd.). It produces protein ingredients through a patented gas-fermentation platform in which a naturally-occurring microorganism converts carbon and energy into a non-GMO single-cell protein, using no arable land and no plant or animal inputs. Its product family includes FeedKind for aquaculture and livestock, FeedKind Pet, FeedKind Net Zero and Positive Protein for human food ingredients; FeedKind Aqua is sold globally through Calysseo, a 50/50 joint venture with Adisseo whose first production plant in China manufactures thousands of tonnes per year. Calysta sells physical protein ingredients to feed and food manufacturers — its fermentation platform is industrial process technology, not commercial software — and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Checkerspot
providers.description: Checkerspot is an Alameda, California biotechnology company, founded in 2016 and incorporated as a Public Benefit Corporation, that designs and produces functional fats and oils through precision fermentation of microalgae. Its biology-driven molecule licensing platform pairs algal strain development, an advanced analytical platform, bioinformatics, high-throughput screening, fermentation scale-up and downstream oil refining, built around the proprietary microbe Prototheca moriformis, which the company reports reaches over 80% oil content by dry cell weight. The commercial molecule portfolio includes a high sn-2 palmitate algal oil that mimics the triglyceride structure of human milk fat for infant nutrition, an Omega-7 (palmitoleic acid) algal oil, a designer high-oleic tropical-fat alternative to palm oil, and Algolein tG C18/80 for cosmetic formulation; earlier work commercialized algae-derived urethane composites through the WNDR Alpine outdoor brand. Checkerspot works through ingredient and manufacturing partners including AAK, Huvepharma and La Fabrique Vegetale, and closed a USD 55 million Series C led by ArrowMark Partners with participation from Cox Enterprises. It is a business-to-business ingredient and molecule licensing company rather than a software vendor: it operates a WordPress marketing site, publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and has no GitHub organization.

providers.name: Hungryroot
providers.description: Hungryroot is a personalized grocery and meal-planning service that blends meal-kit convenience with grocery-store variety. Its AI-driven personalization engine builds each customer's cart from dietary preferences, health goals, and budget, drawing on a catalog of 50,000+ recipes and curated grocery products that support high-protein, gluten-free, vegan, and other dietary needs. Hungryroot is a direct-to-consumer company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it operates a consumer web and mobile app experience rather than a public developer platform. This profile was surfaced through the venture portfolio graph and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which probed the provider's domain and public discovery surfaces (no public API, OpenAPI, SDKs, well-known catalog, security.txt, or llms.txt were found as of this pass).

providers.name: Aspect Health
providers.description: Aspect Health is a digital health company offering a science-backed program for women managing PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome). Its PCOS program combines continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), personalized coaching from board-certified health coaches, at-home lab testing for inflammation, hormonal, cardiovascular, and metabolic markers, and the Aida AI dietitian, all delivered through a mobile app. Additional programs cover weight loss, general women's health, and a 21-day check up, with HSA/FSA-eligible plans. Aspect Health is a Techstars-backed company and operates as a consumer (B2C) health platform; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server.

providers.name: Infinant Health
providers.description: Infinant Health (formerly Evolve Biosystems) is a privately held life-sciences company in Sacramento, California, spun out of the Foods for Health Institute at the University of California, Davis after more than a decade of research into the infant gut microbiome. Its foundational discovery is B. infantis EVC001, a strain of Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis that metabolizes human milk oligosaccharides and has largely disappeared from infants in industrialized countries. The company commercializes that strain as Evivo, a consumer infant probiotic sold direct-to-consumer and through retail, and is developing INF108 as a drug candidate intended to reduce necrotizing enterocolitis in premature infants. Infinant Health is a biotechnology and consumer-health manufacturer rather than a software company: it publishes clinical trials, peer-reviewed publications and investor material, but no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract could be found on any of its hosts.

providers.name: Pendulum
providers.description: Pendulum (Pendulum Therapeutics, pendulumlife.com) is a microbiome-management and metabolic-health company that develops clinically validated probiotic supplements built on novel, patented anaerobic microbial strains such as Akkermansia muciniphila. Its consumer products - including Glucose Control, Metabolic Daily, Akkermansia, and a GLP-1 probiotic - are formulated to fuel and maintain the gut lining, support immunity, relieve gas and bloating, and help keep blood glucose in a healthy range, differentiated by double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trials rather than off-the-shelf probiotic blends. Pendulum is a direct-to-consumer health and supplement brand and is a portfolio company of DCVC; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Second Nature
providers.description: Second Nature is a UK-based digital weight-loss programme that combines NHS-trusted, CQC-regulated clinical care with dietitian-led coaching and behaviour-change support. The service pairs weight-loss medication (including Wegovy, Mounjaro, oral semaglutide and Orlistat programmes) with personalised medication reviews, a mobile app for tracking, and a science-based content library of guides and member stories. It operates as a registered pharmacy, supports NHS referrals and partnerships, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass Second Nature publishes a consumer marketing site and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: The Fit Body Co
providers.description: The Fit Body Co (Fitbody) is a Mexican direct-to-consumer sports nutrition and dietary supplements brand selling isolated and hydrolyzed protein powders, creatine, vitamins, and wellness products, along with digital recipe guides, through a Shopify-based online storefront at fitbody.mx. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As an e-commerce retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: ElCoach
providers.description: ElCoach (الكوتش) is a Cairo, Egypt based fitness and nutrition technology company serving the Middle East and North Africa. Its bilingual Arabic/English mobile app delivers personalized workout routines and healthy meal plans tailored to each user, combining certified trainers and nutritionists with AI-driven personalization. The product is a consumer subscription app distributed on iOS and Android with in-app payments; it does not publish a public developer API program. ElCoach is backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), Endure Capital, Wise Capital, and the Misk 500 MENA and Google accelerators, and was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Geltor
providers.description: Geltor is a biodesign company founded in 2015 by Alex Lorestani and Nick Ouzounov that engineers animal-free designer proteins, peptides and polypeptides and manufactures them through precision fermentation. Its Biodesigner AI computational biology platform is used to imagine, screen and optimize novel protein sequences, which are then scaled commercially as ingredients for beauty and personal care, specialty nutrition and medical/life-science applications. The portfolio includes HumaColl 21 (biomimetic human collagen), HumaColl 21 Select (a matrikine peptide complex), Elastapure (biomimetic human elastin), Collume and Caviance (vegan collagens) and PrimaColl, a Type XXI signaling collagen and the first biotech-derived collagen to receive an FDA GRAS "no questions" letter for ingestible use. Geltor sells business-to-business to brand formulators and manufacturers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Blue Apron
providers.description: Blue Apron is a direct-to-consumer meal-kit and prepared-food delivery company that ships chef-designed recipes with pre-portioned fresh ingredients on a weekly, no-commitment basis. Its consumer-facing surface spans meal kits, assembly-and-bake meals, ready-to-eat prepared dishes, and family-style options ordered and managed through blueapron.com and its mobile apps. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners, Blue Apron operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription platform with no public developer program, API portal, or documented API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Little Freddie
providers.description: Little Freddie (Sunny Fields Enterprise Ltd) is a UK-based organic baby and toddler food brand producing nutritious weaning products for infants from six months, developed with a paediatric dietitian to meet UK and EU baby-food guidelines. Its ranges include Greek-style yoghurts, Simply Fruit purees, Full of Veg meals, dairy-free alternatives, home-style meals and omega-3 "Good for Brains" options, sold through major UK retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, Co-op, Ocado, Booths and Spar. The company also runs a Parenting Hub with weaning, nutrition and parenting content. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; this profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Notti
providers.description: Notti (Notti Pet Food) is a Malaysian pet-nutrition startup selling premium slow-baked kibble, treats, and supplements for dogs (Wou Wou) and cats (Mau Mau) direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront. Formulations emphasise ">=80% fresh meat", low-temperature slow-baking to preserve nutrients, no meat meal or by-products, and AAFCO-compliant nutrition with no chemical preservatives. The company is seed-funded, has been covered by Malaysian business press (The Edge, The Star, Business Today, Free Malaysia Today), and is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company. Notti operates as a consumer e-commerce and retail brand and publishes no developer API, documentation, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Alcresta Therapeutics
providers.description: Alcresta Therapeutics is a specialty pharmaceutical company developing enzyme-based products that improve fat absorption and digestive health for people with rare and chronic conditions. Its lead product, the RELiZORB (immobilized lipase) cartridge, uses the company's patented iLipase microbead technology to mimic pancreatic lipase and hydrolyze fats in enteral (tube) feeding formulas, helping patients with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, cystic fibrosis, short bowel syndrome, and critical-care nutrition needs absorb fatty acids they otherwise could not. Alcresta is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company operates a corporate and product marketing website but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Fay
providers.description: Fay (Fay Health, Inc.) is a digital-health marketplace that connects members with registered dietitians and nutritionists and handles the insurance billing so nutrition counseling is covered — often at little or no out-of-pocket cost. The platform offers telehealth consultations, personalized meal planning, and support for chronic condition management, backed by iOS and Android apps and a member help center. Fay reports 4,000+ registered dietitians, 700+ accepted insurance plans, and 100,000+ members. It is backed by Forerunner Ventures and General Catalyst and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; Fay publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Heltia
providers.description: Heltia is a Turkish digital mental-health and employee-wellbeing platform (an Employee Assistance Platform, EAP) that connects individuals and corporate employees with licensed psychologists and dietitians for online therapy, counseling and nutrition support. Its consumer app offers video sessions with experts, self-assessment tests (anxiety, depression, OCD, motivation) and an expert-reviewed blog, while its corporate products — Esenlik (wellbeing), Sağlık Yönetimi (health management) and brokerage — give employers measurable workforce mental-health programs. Backed by Northzone. Heltia does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: The Feed
providers.description: The Feed is an online sports nutrition store for endurance athletes, stocking products from more than 300 brands across fuel, hydration, supplements, and recovery. Founded by Matt Johnson while managing a Tour de France cycling team, it sells gels, chews, and drink mixes as single servings so athletes can test products without committing to full boxes, offers AutoShip subscriptions and a Feed First membership, and is the official nutrition partner of USA Triathlon. The company builds personalized fueling plans around before/during/after-workout nutrition, tested with input from over 200,000 athletes. It is a consumer e-commerce brand (Shopify storefront) with no public developer API; its machine-readable surfaces are a published llms.txt and a Google Merchant product feed.

providers.name: Nourish
providers.description: Nourish is a virtual nutrition-counseling telehealth platform that connects patients with Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) through insurance-covered video appointments in all 50 states. Its network of more than 10,000 dietitians supports conditions including diabetes, eating disorders, heart health, and gut health, and a companion mobile app handles meal and goal tracking, secure messaging, lab-work review, and between-session support. Nourish verifies insurance and submits claims on the patient's behalf, with the company reporting that 94% of patients pay $0 out of pocket. Backed by Index Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Susa Ventures, the company raised a $100M Series C. Nourish exposes a consumer marketing and patient-app surface only; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: DietlyAPI
providers.description: Food & nutrition data REST API with 4.2M+ foods, calories, macros, 17 micronutrients, barcode lookup, and confidence-ranked full-text search. Data primarily from Open Food Facts (ODbL), EU-hosted, with key-optional read access.

providers.name: Golden Child
providers.description: Golden Child is a direct-to-consumer pet wellness brand offering fresh, human-grade, vet-formulated dog food delivered on a subscription basis. Founded in 2025 by former Hims & Hers leaders Quentin Lacornerie and Jack Abraham, the company pairs science-backed "main" meals with taste-driven "drizzle" toppers, guided by a two-minute intake quiz that builds a personalized meal plan for each dog. It operates a Shopify Hydrogen storefront at mygoldenchild.com and has raised $37M from Redpoint Ventures, Atomic, and A*. Golden Child publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile tracks it as a company in the API Evangelist network, surfaced from the Redpoint Ventures portfolio.

providers.name: Numan
providers.description: Numan (trading as Vir Health Limited) is a UK-based digital healthcare and telemedicine company offering convenient, clinician-led care direct to consumers. Its services span weight-loss programmes (including GLP-1 medications such as Mounjaro and Wegovy), men's health (erectile dysfunction, hair loss, testosterone), women's health (menopause support), at-home blood tests and diagnostics, supplements, and one-off doctor consultations, delivered through its website and iOS/Android app. Numan is regulated by the Care Quality Commission and operates a GPhC-licensed pharmacy. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. As of this enrichment pass Numan publishes no public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: Eucalyptus
providers.description: Eucalyptus (eucalyptus.health) is a global digital healthcare company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia, that builds and operates patient-first telehealth clinics. It runs four consumer digital-health brands — Juniper (women's weight management and menopause), Pilot (men's health, hair loss, sexual health and weight), Software (clinical-grade skincare and dermatology) and Kin (reproductive, fertility and postpartum care) — across Australia, the United Kingdom, Germany, Japan and Canada, pairing licensed practitioners with technology and connected-care tooling. Eucalyptus was acquired by Hims & Hers Health in June 2026. This profile is a consumer-facing healthtech company: it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to verified corporate identity, published website properties, a responsible-disclosure program, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Ritual
providers.description: Ritual is a direct-to-consumer health and wellness brand that sells traceable, scientifically-formulated vitamins and nutritional supplements, best known for its Essential for Women multivitamin, prenatal and postnatal formulas, and protein products. The company emphasizes a "clean label" approach with a visible, traceable supply chain and university-backed clinical studies, sold primarily through a subscription model on ritual.com. As of this enrichment pass Ritual operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: truBrain
providers.description: truBrain is a Santa Monica, California nootropics and functional-beverage brand that makes "natural superfuels for performance" — drinkable nootropic shots (2,000mg of natural nootropics per 1oz bottle for focus and motivation), drinkable ketones (Ketone XL, 11g of pure ketones per shot for athletic energy and recovery), plus gummies, functional-mushroom blends, capsules, NAD+, hydration, and sleep supplements, packaged in recycled paper bottles. Founded by a team of neuroscientists and backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and has run a Regulation A+ public equity offering. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network. truBrain is a consumer packaged-goods company: it publishes no first-party developer API, documentation, or SDKs. The only machine-readable surface at its domain is Shopify's Customer Accounts OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 discovery metadata.

providers.name: 1Balance
providers.description: 1Balance (1Balance Living) is a personalized herbal-wellness and tea brand offering curated caffeinated and caffeine-free tisane blends formulated for different times of day — spanning gut health, energy, metabolism, adaptogenic immune support, relaxation, and menopause support. The company blends traditional herbal science and personalization (drawing on Ayurveda and naturopathy) with modern subscription commerce, selling whole-herb capsule and loose-leaf tea blends directly to consumers through a Shopify-powered storefront with free shipping over $30 and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Backed by an Accel-led seed round, 1Balance operates as a US/India direct-to-consumer consumer-wellness company. This API Evangelist profile tracks 1Balance as a consumer brand; it runs a retail e-commerce experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: DayDayCook
providers.description: DayDayCook is a home-cooking content-to-commerce platform founded in Hong Kong that publishes recipes, cooking videos, and food storytelling (its "Taste & Tales" blog) alongside a direct-to-consumer shop selling its own branded sauces, ingredients, and prepared foods under the tagline "Easy Cooking, Festive Flavours." The business pairs a culinary media audience with a consumer-packaged-goods and e-commerce operation. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass DayDayCook publishes a consumer web presence and online shop but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: GymNadz
providers.description: GymNadz is a women-focused fitness application offering personalized workout programs, nutrition and meal plans, and community features. The platform provides a library of 300+ exercises with customizable workout and meal plans tailored to individual fitness goals, plus progress tracking and coach interaction. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps rather than as a developer platform. GymNadz is a portfolio company of 500 Global, tracked in the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Gousto
providers.description: Gousto is a British meal-kit retailer founded in 2012 by Timo Boldt and James Carter and headquartered in Shepherd's Bush, London. It delivers recipe boxes with pre-portioned fresh ingredients and step-by-step recipes to homes across the UK, using proprietary data science, ERP, courier-integration and warehouse-automation systems to run its subscription operation. A SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company, Gousto does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public digital surface (website, engineering blog, GitHub organization, and coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Encurate
providers.description: Encurate provides a Keto Diet API offering over 450 keto recipes across 11 categories (drinks, smoothies, staples, dips, desserts, soups, fish, beef, appetizers, snacks, and breakfast) with structured nutritional values including calories, fats, carbohydrates, and proteins. The REST API returns JSON and is distributed via RapidAPI with a free testing tier and a paid unlimited production tier for integration into health, fitness, and nutrition applications.

providers.name: Flavrs
providers.description: Flavrs is a consumer food and cooking platform "made for people who live to eat" that pairs short-form cooking videos from notable chefs and food creators (including Eric Ripert and Binging with Babish) with structured recipe data and integrated ingredient shopping, so viewers can watch a dish being made and buy everything they need to cook it in a single app. Backed by a16z and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile, Flavrs has since merged with the meal-delivery service CookUnity and now redirects its audience there. Flavrs operates as a mobile consumer application and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its real identity, legal, and social properties for network completeness.

providers.name: Napkin Math
providers.description: Napkin Math is a personalized AI food journal from Paper Star (a Y Combinator company, founded 2026 in San Francisco by Manuel Castro, Claire Nord, and Jynnie Tang). Marketed as "an AI nutrition coach in your pocket," it is a simple, beautiful food diary that helps people log meals and understand their eating habits over time. The product is a consumer mobile application rather than a developer platform: as of this profile Napkin Math publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This entry is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead; it will be upgraded to carry API artifacts if and when Napkin Math or Paper Star exposes a public API surface.

providers.name: Petual
providers.description: Petual is a direct-to-consumer pet wellness brand offering functional soft chews for dogs. The company sells six formulas — Thrive (daily longevity), Steady (calm & stress), Nourish (digestive & gut health), Soothe (skin & allergy), Spring (mobility & joint), and Lean (healthy weight & metabolism) — each an apothecary-style canister of 90 chews (9.5 oz) positioned as a daily ritual for a longer, healthier canine life. Backed by a16z and Cowboy Ventures. Petual publishes a consumer storefront only — no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, well-known discovery, or agent surface was found. This profile tracks the company as a network lead and will be enriched if and when a developer program appears.

providers.name: Foodvisor
providers.description: Foodvisor is a mobile nutrition platform whose Vision API uses computer vision and AI to identify food items from photographs and return nutritional information including calories, macronutrients, and serving estimates. The Vision API is offered to enterprise developers under a commercial agreement.

providers.name: Nutrisystem (Wellina by Nutrisystem)
providers.description: Nutrisystem is a direct-to-consumer subscription meal delivery service for weight loss, founded in 1972 by Harold Katz and headquartered in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania. The company pioneered prepackaged weight-loss meal subscriptions, transitioned from physical retail to a direct-to-consumer Internet and telephone model in 1999, and added mobile delivery beginning in 2010. Nutrisystem is now operated under the marketing umbrella "Wellina by Nutrisystem" — a multi-brand health and wellness marketplace covering Nutrisystem, Jenny Craig, High Protein, Menopause Support, Low Carb (GLP-1 friendly), and the Club Advantage à la carte membership. The legal operating entity is Nutrisystem, LLC, a subsidiary of Wellful, Inc. (the parent organization formed after Kainos Capital acquired Nutrisystem from Tivity Health in October 2020). Tivity Health no longer owns the brand. Wellful's portfolio also includes South Beach Diet (acquired by Nutrisystem in December 2015 for $15 million) and the Jenny Craig intellectual property (acquired by Wellful in fall 2023 after Jenny Craig's Chapter 7 bankruptcy and relaunched as an e-commerce meal-delivery brand). LinkedIn classifies the company under Wellness and Fitness Services with 501–1,000 employees. Stephen Mikulak was named President in 2021. Nutrisystem publishes no public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, or developer portal. Its only digital surface beyond the e-commerce sites is the consumer-facing Nutrisystem mobile app (iOS / Android) for food logging, weight tracking, journaling, and meal-plan adjustments — and the equivalent Jenny Craig app — neither of which advertise integrations with Apple Health, Google Fit, Fitbit, or any third-party platform. The github.com/nutrisystem GitHub organization exists but contains a single inactive CSS repository last updated in March 2015. The technology footprint is a closed consumer subscription stack with no public developer touchpoints.

providers.name: 8fit
providers.description: 8fit is a consumer health and fitness application offering personalized home workout programs (HIIT, boxing, Pilates, yoga, and meditation), custom healthy meal and nutrition plans, and holistic wellness guidance built around sustainable habit-building rather than quick fixes. Founded in Berlin and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Creandum, 8fit reached more than 40 million downloads before being acquired by Withings (a Gilde Healthcare portfolio company) in February 2022. Withings announced the discontinuation of the standalone 8fit app effective June 26, 2026, folding its nutrition and activity content into the Withings app and Withings+ service. 8fit is a mobile/web consumer app and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Campbell Soup
providers.description: Campbell Soup Company (now rebranded as The Campbell's Company) is a manufacturer and marketer of high-quality branded convenience food products, including soups, simple meals, beverages, snacks, and packaged fresh foods under brands such as Campbell's, Swanson, Pace, Prego, V8, Pepperidge Farm, Goldfish, and Snyder's of Hanover. Historically Campbell's ran a public Campbell's Kitchen Developer API exposing recipes, products, UPC lookup, and nutrition data for web and mobile integrations, though current availability of the public developer portal varies and typically requires partner access.

providers.name: Chefs for Seniors
providers.description: Chefs for Seniors is an in-home personal chef service for older adults, founded in 2013 by Barrett and Nathan Allman. Locally-owned franchise chefs come to a senior's home to plan menus, grocery shop, and cook 10-15 servings of fresh, customized meals each visit for about the cost of meal delivery. Menus rotate across 175+ options and accommodate diabetic, low-sodium, kidney-friendly, vegetarian, and other dietary needs, reviewed by a Registered Dietitian. The company operates across roughly 99 US locations, serves about 15,000 clients, and has prepared over 2.5 million meals. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Chefs for Seniors publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: DailyMealz
providers.description: DailyMealz is a Saudi Arabia-based meal subscription service that delivers fresh daily lunches and full-day meal plans sourced from a network of more than sixty partner restaurants. Subscribers choose a package (healthy, keto, diet, and similar options), select meals from a rotating menu, and control delivery timing through the DailyMealz mobile app. The company also operates a DailyMealz for Business offering for corporate meal programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; DailyMealz is an app-first consumer brand and publishes no public developer API surface, documentation portal, or API specifications as of this profiling round.

providers.name: Gabit
providers.description: Gabit is a one-stop health and wellness platform on a mission to add more healthy years to people's lives. Headquartered in Gurugram, India and founded in 2022 by Gaurav Gupta (ex-Zomato cofounder) and Arpana Shahi, Gabit treats health as an interconnected system across four pillars — fitness, nutrition, sleep, and mindfulness. Its consumer ecosystem spans the titanium Gabit Smart Ring, a smart body-composition scale, at-home Blood Work diagnostics, a continuous glucose monitor (CGM), the Sweden-born Näck nutrition supplement line, all-good-no-harm skincare, and coached Fitness & Nutrition Plans — all unified in the Gabit app, which tracks 150+ biomarkers and includes the free PEP AI health coach. India is the primary market, with Ring-only storefronts in the UAE and UK and an informational US/global page.

providers.name: THG
providers.description: THG plc (formerly The Hut Group) is a UK-based consumer brands group founded in 2004 in Manchester and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Following the 2025 demerger of its Ingenuity technology and fulfilment division, THG is a pure-play consumer brands business operating two divisions: THG Beauty (home to Lookfantastic, Cult Beauty, Dermstore and prestige brand partners) and THG Nutrition (led by Myprotein, one of the world's largest online sports-nutrition brands). THG designs, manufactures and sells beauty and nutrition products direct-to-consumer across global markets. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital, an early investor. THG operates corporate, investor-relations and careers web properties but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Campbell's
providers.description: Campbell's (Campbell Soup Company, now The Campbell's Company) is the consumer brand trusted for generations to provide authentic, flavourful, and readily available soups, meals, and recipes. Alongside its consumer website, Campbell's has historically operated a Campbell's Kitchen Developer API that let developers embed Campbell's, Swanson, Pace, Prego, and Pepperidge Farm recipes, products, and nutrition data into their own web and mobile experiences.

providers.name: Nutrition & Exercise API
providers.description: The Dietagram Nutrition API is designed to simplify the integration of your application with Dietagram's extensive food database and nutritional standards. Rather than developing and maintaining your own nutrient database, you can rely on Dietagram for high-quality source data.

providers.name: Bota Biosciences
providers.description: Bota Biosciences (Bota Bio, 恩和科技) is an industrial and synthetic biology company that applies AI-driven computation and laboratory automation to bio-manufacturing. Its in-house Bota Biofoundry and Cell2Cloud platforms combine computational algorithms, non-model industrial strain engineering, rapid iterative enzyme engineering and performance protein design to shorten design-build-test-learn cycles, and in March 2026 it launched SAION AI, a three-layer "Physical AI" platform (cognition, orchestration, execution) that drives laboratory hardware through a proprietary Biological Protocol Language. Bota commercializes this work as physical ingredients rather than software: Purtect bio-preservatives (nisin, natamycin, ε-poly-lysine, lysozyme), Prorylia biomimetic proteins and Re² Coffea Arabica peptides, sold through its HeliaGenesis food and nutrition brand and its YuccaElements personal care brand, with partnerships including BASF, Proya, Syensqo and Puratos. Founded in 2019 with operations in Hangzhou, China and the San Francisco Bay Area, Bota publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable specification; its computational software is internal laboratory tooling and its SAION AI application is reachable only through a login with an administrator-managed account whitelist.

providers.name: Revolution Foods
providers.description: Revolution Foods is an Oakland, California food company founded in 2006 by Kristin Groos Richmond and Kirsten Saenz Tobey that manufactures and delivers nutritious, freshly prepared meals to schools and senior communities. It is the largest K-12 school meal vendor in California, serving more than 35 million meals a year across 800+ schools and senior centers, with programs spanning district and charter school food service, after-school and summer meals, senior center dining and homebound delivery. The company has been a Certified B Corporation since 2009 and a Public Benefit Corporation since 2021, and reports a 100% audit pass rate across NSLP, SBP, CACFP, SFSP and Title III compliance. Customers order through Centro, a login-gated web ordering portal; Revolution Foods publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Monell Chemical Senses Center
providers.description: The Monell Chemical Senses Center is "the world's only independent, non-profit scientific institute dedicated to interdisciplinary basic research on the senses of taste and smell." Founded in 1968 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Monell conducts chemosensory research organized around three strategic themes: Healthy Senses and Happy Lives, Senses for a Thriving Planet, and Nourishing Our Future. The center runs postdoctoral training, the Dr. Charis Eng Monell Science Apprenticeship Program, the Monell Science Entrepreneurship Program, an Academic Partnership Program, and the Monell Insiders corporate partnership program. Monell does not publish a public developer API surface; its "product" is knowledge disseminated through scholarly publications and conferences.

providers.name: Jow
providers.description: Jow is a consumer meal-planning and grocery-shopping application that turns personalized menu selection into an automated shopping list. From a catalog of thousands of recipes tailored to household size, dietary preferences and goals (keto, vegetarian, high-protein, gluten-free, kid-friendly, low-calorie), Jow builds a weekly menu and generates the matching grocery order, which users check out through integrated grocery-retail partnerships at optimized prices. Founded in France and available as iOS and Android mobile apps, Jow serves millions of active users. It is a portfolio company of Northzone. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Sun Basket
providers.description: Sun Basket is a San Francisco-based meal-kit and prepared-meal delivery service offering organic, chef-designed recipes and ingredients shipped as weekly subscription boxes, with menus spanning dietary programs such as paleo, keto, vegetarian, gluten-free, and diabetes-friendly options. Surfaced as a portfolio company of sapphire-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, Sun Basket operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription-delivery product; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment probing.

providers.name: CHS Inc.
providers.description: CHS Inc. is a Fortune 500 diversified, integrated, global agricultural cooperative owned by farmers, ranchers, cooperatives, and individual producers. Headquartered in Inver Grove Heights, Minnesota, CHS describes itself as the largest farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, with more than 750 member cooperatives, 75,000+ individual producer-owners, and 20,000+ preferred stockholders. The cooperative serves customers in 65 countries through three primary business divisions: Agriculture (crop nutrients, crop protection, precision agriculture, seed, animal nutrition, and oilseed products), Energy (refined fuels, propane, lubricants, pipelines, terminals, and renewable fuels under the Cenex brand), and Services (hedging, payment solutions, transportation, and capital services). Major brands include Cenex, Allegiant (seed), Payback (animal nutrition), and N-Edge (crop nutrients). CHS does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are provided through digital platforms such as MyCHS (online portal for grain tickets, billing, and payments) and CHS Connect (digital self-service for crop protection and energy wholesale customers).

providers.name: GNC Holdings
providers.description: GNC Holdings, LLC (General Nutrition Centers) is an American specialty retailer of health, wellness, and performance products including vitamins, minerals, herbal supplements, sports nutrition, diet, and energy products. Founded in 1935 and headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, GNC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Harbin Pharmaceutical Group following its 2020 acquisition. The company operates owned and franchised retail locations, online stores, and retail partnerships across approximately 50 countries.

providers.name: Conagra Brands
providers.description: Conagra Brands is a leading North American branded consumer packaged goods (CPG) food company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. Its portfolio of iconic frozen, refrigerated, and shelf-stable brands includes Marie Callender's, Healthy Choice, Slim Jim, Reddi-wip, Hunt's, Banquet, Birds Eye, Duncan Hines, and Orville Redenbacher's. Conagra internally describes itself as API-first across its digital estate, but does not publish any public developer APIs at this time. Partner integrations such as foodservice, retail, and supplier portals are managed via direct B2B agreements rather than a public developer surface.

providers.name: HelloFresh
providers.description: HelloFresh SE is a publicly listed (Frankfurt Stock Exchange: HFG), Berlin-headquartered global meal-kit and food-solutions company that ships recipes and pre-portioned ingredients to households across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Its brand portfolio includes HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Youfoodz, and Good Chop. HelloFresh does not publish a public consumer developer API; its engineering organization is active in open source on GitHub, maintaining widely used infrastructure tooling such as the Janus API gateway, the health-go healthcheck library, and the goengine event-sourcing framework. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and Insight Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.description: Data about various grocery products and foods

providers.description: Nutrition Analysis

providers.description: Data about all kinds of fruit

providers.description: Recipes, ingredients, nutrition data and cooking instructions

providers.description: API to query data about recipe, plan, ingredients

providers.name: Limbo
providers.description: Limbo is a direct-to-consumer digital weight-loss and metabolic-health program operated by Vitals in View, Inc., with subsidiaries in the UK (company no. 15047668) and Ireland (company no. 725671). Members wear a body-worn "energy sensor" that reads metabolic signals, and a companion app turns those readings into personalized, nudge-based guidance intended to change eating habits without calorie counting. The company is Seedcamp-backed, raised a seed round in September 2022, and is mid-rebrand from Limbo (limborevolution.com) to Viv (viv.co), with the marketing site now served from content.viv.co. Limbo publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and probed security posture only.

providers.name: Colgate-Palmolive
providers.description: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer-products manufacturer operating in oral care, personal care, home care, and pet nutrition through brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, Hill's Pet Nutrition, Speed Stick, Ajax, and Softsoap. Colgate-Palmolive does not publish a general-purpose public developer REST API. Its B2B integration footprint is centered on EDI exchanges with retail trading partners (X12 messages, AS2, VAN), supplier integrations through SAP Ariba, and internal corporate systems. There is also a corporate sustainability and ESG reporting surface, but it is not exposed as a developer API.

providers.name: ConAgra Foods
providers.description: ConAgra Foods, Inc. was the prior corporate name of Conagra Brands. In 2015 the company spun off its foodservice ingredients business as Lamb Weston and renamed the remaining packaged-foods business to Conagra Brands, Inc. This profile is preserved as a historical alias; the active company profile lives at the conagra-brands repository. No public developer APIs were ever published under the ConAgra Foods brand.

providers.name: NBTY
providers.description: NBTY was a leading global vertically integrated manufacturer, marketer, distributor, and retailer of vitamins and nutritional supplements before being renamed The Nature's Bounty Co., which was subsequently sold and reorganized. No public APIs exist under the NBTY name.

providers.name: CucumberTown
providers.description: Cucumbertown was a recipe network and food-blogging platform ("a Tumblr for recipes") founded around 2011-2012 in Palo Alto, California by Cherian Thomas, Chris Luscher, Arun Prabhakar and Dan Hauk, and backed by 500 Startups (now 500 Global) among other angel investors. It let home cooks and food bloggers publish, structure, and share recipes on a hosted network. Cucumbertown was acquired by the Japanese recipe network Cookpad in June 2015 and was fully shut down by March 31, 2017 for lack of a sustainable business model. The company is defunct and operates no public API or developer program. The cucumbertown.com domain now 302-redirects to Samsung Food (app.samsungfood.com, formerly Whisk), an unrelated successor product; none of the artifacts served on that host belong to Cucumbertown.

providers.name: FreshDish
providers.description: FreshDish (Fresh Dish, Inc.) was a Santa Monica meal-kit delivery startup founded in 2012 by Steve Goldstein (formerly SVP/GM at Provide Commerce, the ProFlowers and Shari's Berries operator). Incubated by Science Inc. and seeded with $500,000 from Battery Ventures, it shipped ready-to-cook dinner kits with chef-designed recipes and pre-portioned ingredients (two-person kits at $24, family-of-four at $32, free shipping). The company was deadpooled and is no longer operating; the freshdish.com domain now resolves to a parked/for-sale lander. It was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. FreshDish never operated a developer program, public API, or SDKs, so there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Land O'Lakes
providers.description: Land O'Lakes is a member-owned agricultural cooperative providing food, agriculture, and animal nutrition products to farmers, retailers, and consumers, with brands including Land O'Lakes butter and Purina Animal Nutrition.

providers.name: McCormick
providers.description: McCormick spices and products have been kitchen must-haves since 1889. Learn about seasoning and cuisine while discovering tons of delicious recipes today. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: MealPal
providers.description: MealPal is a consumer meal subscription service that lets members reserve lunch or dinner from a rotating selection of local restaurants at a discounted, fixed membership price, ordering ahead through its iOS and Android apps to skip the line at pickup. The service is organized around its MealPass lunch/dinner subscription and MealFix offering, alongside a partner program that restaurants join to reach members. MealPal operates as a business-to-consumer mobile application and website and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: plated
providers.description: Plated was a meal-kit delivery company surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The company was acquired by Albertsons in 2017 and later wound down; the plated.com domain now 301-redirects to safeway.com, and no independent developer portal, API reference, SDK, or well-known surface remains. This profile records the honest state of a defunct provider with no active API surface.

providers.name: Simple Feast
providers.description: Simple Feast was a Danish plant-based, ready-to-eat meal company surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the consumer app host food.simplefeast.com no longer resolves and the root domain simplefeast.com is parked on one.com nameservers, so the company appears defunct. No developer portal, API, documentation, or other machine-readable API surface could be discovered during enrichment; this profile is retained as a historical portfolio lead.

providers.name: SimplyCook
providers.description: SimplyCook is a UK-based recipe-box and meal-flavoring subscription service (tagline "For simple pleasures, SimplyCook.") that ships monthly boxes of flavor pots, stocks, and spice blends alongside curated recipes so subscribers can cook varied meals at home in around twenty minutes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. SimplyCook operates as a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand; it runs an internal application backend at api.simplycook.com but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile therefore carries only what could be genuinely probed: DNS/TLS/HTTP domain-security posture for the company domain.

providers.name: LemonBox
providers.description: LemonBox (来檬) is a health-technology brand working in AI-generative personalized nutrition. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, incubated at the University of Chicago Polsky Center in 2017, and accepted into Y Combinator in 2018, it entered the Chinese market that year and is now headquartered in Shanghai. LemonBox builds individualized daily vitamin and supplement packs from a three-minute FFQ (food frequency questionnaire) nutrition assessment scored by its LemonAlgo adaptive engine, then fulfills them one pack at a time (MOQ=1) through its Personalization Fulfillment Center in Hong Kong. The company reports serving more than 10 million cumulative users as of 2026 and sells both direct-to-consumer and B2B. Investors include Y Combinator and Partech. LemonBox operates a consumer web and WeChat mini-program experience and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its agent-facing surface is limited to a published /llms.txt and a robots.txt that explicitly allow-lists generative-AI crawlers.

providers.name: Mead Johnson Nutrition
providers.description: Mead Johnson Nutrition was a manufacturer of infant formula and other pediatric nutrition products before being acquired by Reckitt Benckiser in 2017. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Nu Skin Enterprises
providers.description: Nu Skin Enterprises is a global multilevel marketing company that develops and distributes personal care products and dietary supplements through a network of independent distributors. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Ample
providers.description: Ample Foods is a nutrition company that makes single-serving meal-replacement shakes sold direct-to-consumer at amplemeal.com. Its lineup includes Ample Original, a low-carb meal shake with roughly 25g protein and 4g net carbs per 400-calorie serving, and Ample Recover, a higher-carb performance shake with about 31g protein and 33g carbs per 400-calorie serving, sold in ready-to-drink bottles and bulk canisters. Ample is a consumer packaged-goods brand running on a Shopify storefront; enrichment probing found no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or API reference. This profile is a portfolio lead backed by 500 Global and is retained as a company record with no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Hims & Hers Health
providers.description: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth platform headquartered in San Francisco that connects consumers with licensed providers and ships personalized treatments across men's and women's health categories. Hims serves men with offerings spanning sexual health, hair loss, mental health, dermatology, and weight loss; Hers serves women with birth control, hair, skin, mental health, and weight management; both brands include compounded GLP-1 weight-loss programs. International expansion has been driven by the acquisitions of ZAVA (Europe, 2025) and Eucalyptus Health (Australia, 2026). Hims & Hers is primarily a consumer D2C product; no public developer API has been identified, and B2B and partner integrations are gated. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Purmeo
providers.description: PURMEO GmbH is a German ("Made in Germany") manufacturer and direct-to-consumer retailer of high-quality nutritional supplements, vitamins, and minerals, with a focus on digestive health (including H. pylori support), energy, immunity, cognitive function, vision, bone and joint support, and cardiovascular health. Products are formulated without artificial additives, GMOs, or magnesium stearate and are distributed via the company's own online shop as well as Amazon, DocMorris, Medpex, and Shop-Apotheke. Surfaced as a portfolio company of point-nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the enrichment pass this is a B2C e-commerce business with no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Reckitt Benckiser
providers.description: Reckitt Benckiser is a British multinational consumer-goods company focused on health, hygiene, and nutrition. Its portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Lysol, Dettol, Mucinex, Strepsils, Nurofen, Veet, Finish, Vanish, Air Wick, Calgon, Durex, and Enfamil/Mead Johnson infant nutrition, sold in nearly 200 markets. Reckitt operates as a pure consumer packaged-goods company with retail and e-commerce distribution; it does not publish a public developer API or open partner integration portal at the corporate level. B2B trading-partner connectivity with retailers and distributors is handled via standard EDI / GDSN flows rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: besunyen
providers.description: Besunyen is a Chinese consumer-health company known for herbal weight-management, functional and detox teas plus related wellness and nutrition products, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment on 2026-07-18 found no public developer, API, or documentation surface — besunyen.com serves only an nginx 404 and its TLS certificate is issued for besunyen.co (hostname mismatch); the only real artifact captured is a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Boohee
providers.description: Boohee (薄荷健康) is a Chinese consumer health-technology company focused on scientific weight management, serving a cumulative 180 million users over its ~17-year history. Its portfolio spans the Boohee Health mobile app (calorie and food tracking, diet and exercise logging, AI weight-management coaching, meal plans, smart body scales, community), Boohee Life nutritional foods and subscription services, the Boohee Life Internet Hospital (Tianjin-based telemedicine for internal and traditional Chinese medicine), and a Boohee weight-loss SaaS platform that helps hospitals stand up weight-management clinics. The company operates as a consumer mobile and content platform and does not publish a public developer API or open platform; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: PlateJoy
providers.description: PlateJoy is a personalized digital meal-planning and nutrition subscription service that generates customized weekly meal plans, recipes, and auto-built grocery lists from a detailed dietary and lifestyle questionnaire, with grocery-delivery hand-off. Founded in 2012 and later acquired into the Health.com / Dotdash Meredith consumer-health portfolio, it operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile app. As of this enrichment pass PlateJoy exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface. The apex domain has no live web host and the www endpoint resolves to a dangling AWS load balancer, so only domain-level DNS/email security could be probed.

providers.name: SCIWIND
providers.description: Sciwind Biosciences (Hangzhou Sciwind Biosciences Co., Ltd.) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Hangzhou, China, with a US office in San Ramon, California, focused on discovering, developing, and delivering innovative therapeutics for weight management and metabolic disease. Its pipeline spans obesity, type 2 diabetes, and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), led by the GLP-1 receptor agonist Ecnoglutide (advancing through Phase III trials). The company operates proprietary drug-discovery platforms including BiasVantage (biased agonist discovery), OralVantage (oral peptide delivery), and HaleVantage (half-life extension), with 14+ pipeline programs, 120+ researchers, and 110+ patents. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API or developer platform surface.

providers.name: Yacob
providers.description: Yacob was a Dubai-based Intelligent Nutrition platform and 500 Global portfolio company that combined cashless school-meal payments with nutrition monitoring. Pupils paid for school meals with a stored-value card while parents topped up accounts online, tracked transactions in real time, set spend and food limits, flagged allergies, and reviewed the nutritional value of their children's meals. The company appears dormant, with yacob.com no longer resolving as of 2026, and no public API surface was ever found.

providers.name: Endo Health
providers.description: Endo Health is building Glow, an AI-native clinic for women's weight loss. Describing itself as "the emotional layer of healthcare" and aiming to "make health addictive," the company treats the drivers behind symptoms rather than the symptoms alone, delivering conversational, connection-first care through a mobile health app. Its stated mission is to advance human lifespan by one year. Endo Health is backed by General Catalyst and a16z Speedrun, with teams in San Francisco and Seoul. This is a consumer digital-health product; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface has been published at this time.

providers.name: Getsupp
providers.description: Getsupp was an India-based digital health and wellness platform offering supplement and nutrition product discovery, personalized health recommendations, and online consultations with certified experts (nutritionists, dietitians, and coaches). The company was a General Catalyst portfolio company and was subsequently absorbed into Eka.care. As of this enrichment pass the getsupp.in and getsupp.com domains no longer serve a standalone site: both resolve to Eka.io infrastructure (65.0.57.69, TLS cert altnames *.eka.io) and return HTTP 404 for all paths. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, /.well-known/ discovery, or /llms.txt could be found. This profile is retained as a portfolio lead with no enrichable API surface.

providers.name: MycroFriends
providers.description: MycroFriends is a consumer health and wellness company that helps people become healthier through education and coaching centered on the connection between the human microbiome, nutrition, and overall health. Founded by George Cigale (previously founder of the online tutoring company Tutor.com) and headquartered in New York City, the company launched via a 2017 crowdfunding campaign and works with scientists, physicians, dietitians, and technologists to deliver microbiome education, personalized nutritional and lifestyle guidance, and access to expert health coaches. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. As of this enrichment pass MycroFriends publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface, and its former website resolves only to a default (unconfigured) Azure App Service host.

providers.name: Pine Medical
providers.description: Pine Medical was a telehealth provider that offered a medication-supported weight-loss program pairing licensed clinicians with prescription therapies and ongoing patient coaching. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. An enrichment probe on 2026-07-20 found the public website (pinemedical.com) announcing that Pine Medical wound down its medication-supported weight-loss program effective March 30, 2024, and redirects former patients to alternative providers and insurance-covered options. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found.

providers.name: Wecare Probiotics
providers.description: Wecare Probiotics (微康益生菌) is a Chinese biotechnology company specializing in probiotic strain research, intelligent manufacturing, and application solutions for the food, nutrition, and agriculture industries. It operates three research institutes and five intelligent manufacturing facilities across Suzhou, Luohe, and Wuhan, producing product lines including WecLac probiotics, WecPro formula, and WecCul. Its BLa80 strain became the first probiotic strain approved for infant food in mainland China. The company presents a corporate information website only; no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation is published, so this profile carries company identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Weilos
providers.description: Weilos was a health and wellness startup surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of the 2026-07-21 enrichment pass the company no longer operates independently — weilos.com issues a 301 redirect to weightwatchers.com, indicating Weilos has been absorbed into WeightWatchers (WW). No independent developer surface exists — the hosts api.weilos.com, developer.weilos.com, and docs.weilos.com do not resolve in DNS, and there is no public API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal to catalog. This profile is retained as an acquired/defunct lead with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Your Super
providers.description: Your Super (Your Superfoods, Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer plant-based superfoods brand founded in 2015 in Venice, California by Michael Kuech and Kristel de Groot. It sells functional superfood and protein mixes and bars made from five to six nutrient-dense whole-food ingredients that are certified organic, Non-GMO, glyphosate-free, and gluten-free, sold through Shopify storefronts in the US and Europe and via Amazon. The company raised roughly $22.5M across five rounds from investors including 500 Global and PowerPlant Ventures, and was acquired by The Healing Company in October 2022. It is a consumer e-commerce brand and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Before Brands
providers.description: Before Brands, Inc. was a Menlo Park, California science-based food and nutrition company founded on Stanford allergy research by Dr. Kari Nadeau, best known for SpoonfulOne — a consumer early-allergen-introduction product line that blended sixteen commonly allergenic proteins into daily servings for infants and toddlers. Nestle Health Science took a minority stake plus ex-US licensing rights in 2019 and later absorbed the business outright. It was a consumer packaged goods company, not a software company: it never operated a developer program, published no API, SDK or webhook surface, and its own domain is now controlled by Nestle and no longer serves a site.
